scope: Same-host bounded CPU measurements; timings describe these calls, not hosted workflow wall time.

environment.observation: Versions collected when retaining the benchmark; timing samples were measured earlier in the same session.

exact_probability.construction: Eight sectors, four probes per sector, five PARAMETERS plus Fraction(1,7) and Fraction(11,9).

repetition_delay_contract.method: One imported interpreter, three alternating reference/optimized repetitions, replacing only rank_sector_experiments.exact_success_probability.

reference_function:
def exact_success_probability(sector, probe_name, parameter):
    probe = _probe(sector, probe_name)
    value = _parameter(parameter)
    columns = [sector ^ offset for offset in COSET_SUBGROUP]
    matrix = path_matrix(value)
    norm_squared = sum(coordinate**2 for coordinate in probe.coordinates)
    image = [sum(matrix[row, column] * coordinate for column, coordinate in zip(columns, probe.coordinates, strict=True)) for row in range(32)]
    numerator = sum(coordinate**2 for coordinate in image)
    exact_norm = Fraction(int(numerator.p), int(numerator.q))
    probability = exact_norm / (norm_squared * sector_alpha(value) ** 2)
    if not 0 <= probability <= 1:
        raise RuntimeError("exact LCU probability escaped [0,1]")
    return probability

benchmark_program:
import json, sys, time
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "gororoba_quantum")
import rank_sector_experiments as rank
import qpu_planning_contracts as planning
from rank_attachments import path_matrix
artifact = json.loads(Path("docs/evidence/ci_runtime/rank_sector.json").read_text())
namespace = dict(rank.__dict__, path_matrix=path_matrix)
exec(artifact["reference_function"], namespace)
reference = namespace["exact_success_probability"]
optimized = rank.exact_success_probability
cases = [(sector, probe.name, parameter) for sector in range(8) for probe in rank.sector_probes(sector) for parameter in (*rank.PARAMETERS, Fraction(1, 7), Fraction(11, 9))]
for label, implementation in (("reference", reference), ("optimized", optimized)):
    for repeat in range(3):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        probabilities = [implementation(*case) for case in cases]
        print(label, "exact", len(cases), time.perf_counter() - start, str(sum(probabilities)), flush=True)
for repeat in range(3):
    for label, implementation in (("reference", reference), ("optimized", optimized)):
        rank.exact_success_probability = implementation
        start = time.perf_counter()
        planning._verify_rep_delay_range()
        print(label, "rep_delay_range", time.perf_counter() - start, flush=True)
rank.exact_success_probability = optimized
